Performance
Performance Appraisals at TechNova are conducted bi-annually, in June and
December, using the Objective and Key Results (OKR) framework. These reviews are
designed to be constructive, focusing on employee growth, skill development, and
alignment with company goals.
Promotions, salary increments, and performance bonuses are tied to the December
review cycle. Regular 1-on-1 feedback sessions with managers are strongly
encouraged.
